116 sentence contexts · 232 questions shown

Please refer to the sentence/question IDs when suggesting edits. Full comprehension audit · Readable text · Genki I scope

Coverage and progression notes

Two simple and two contrastive variants per word, each with a question focused on target meaning and another on situation meaning. The correct answer need not be the literal target word. All 116 contexts are pending, including new draft replacements for the twelve pilot contexts. Existing approved banks, speech and progress retain their original identities.

Contextual only: 下さい・力いっぱい・大した. These need direct entry into simple contextual practice in a later integration. 人工・人口 retain word cards, with homophones excluded as standalone distractors. The seven bare numerals and ふじ山 remain word-first. This text review does not generate audio, activate cards or save progress.
